markets.rules:
If Parker Washington records 7+ receptions in the Tennessee vs Jacksonville Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
This Contract is designated as protected. If the individual player participates in at least one play during the first half of the game but does not participate in any play after the conclusion of the first half, including any overtime period, this Contract resolves to the fair price prior to the opening kickoff of the game unless the player records the required number of receptions, in which case this Contract settles based on actual statistics. If the player participates in at least one play after the conclusion of the first half, this Contract settles based on actual statistics, regardless of first-half participation.
